## Student projects

BSc/MSc projects and research internships on light, sleep and circadian rhythms. Topics span experiments, evidence synthesis, engineering and social research.

[Browse projects →](student-projects.qmd)

## Research visits

Short visits may be possible when the proposed research is mutually beneficial. Prospective visitors are encouraged to seek external funding.

[Research visits →](research-visits.qmd)
:::

::: {.join-option}
## Wildcard collaborations

Other proposals, including an artist, writer or architect in residence, are considered with a clear goal and work plan.

[Other forms of collaboration →](collaborations.qmd)
:::

::: {.join-option}
## External funding

DAAD, Humboldt and other programmes may support a research stay or fellowship. Contact us to discuss your proposed research and a possible host arrangement.

[Funding and fellowships →](funding.qmd)
:::

## Research in the unit

We study how light, sensory experience and biological rhythms affect human physiology, behaviour and health.

[About the unit](about.qmd) · [How to enquire](apply.qmd)
